description:
Listen to my breathing at the end and you’ll know this is real. 

I broke an irreplaceable ancient time piece that no one on planet earth knows how to fix nor will we ever be able to study it again. 

It was an accident that happened when we were filming longform of these artifacts. I bumped the stone slab ￼and it fell on top of the Timepiece, breaking both of them. As soon as it happened, I felt terrible and you can hear the urgency in my voice. After a few moments, I balled up in a corner shaking uncontrollably and not speaking. Alx finally got me up and going long enough to finish the recording after which I fell silent and did not speak a word for almost 36 hours. That night I went to bed in my dirty clothes without brushing my teeth, taking a shower or even removing my hat. Alx watched me out of concern for hours that night and said that I was shaking, whimpering and trembling as if in pain all night long. Two days later, I developed physical symptoms and was in bed for four or five days, which is highly irregular for me. I haven’t seen a doctor in over 14 years and I’m in great health. I also have just felt changed for lack of a better word. A lot more still and quiet as if something shifted around me internally.

I’m not sure what happened, but I know I feel terrible about my mistake and there is nothing I can do but apologize.  

Do you think I’m cursed?
